Licensed product information in the UK states that no dosage adjustment is gener- ally necessary for parecoxib in patients with mild hepatic impair- ment (Child-Pugh score 5 or 6). For those with moderate impair- ment (Child-Pugh score 7 to 9) parecoxib should be given at half the usual dose (see above), repeated to a maximum dose of 40 mg daily. Use in patients with severe impairment (Child-Pugh score 10 and over) is not recommended as there is no clinical experience in such patients.
